Subject: POC trial: success criteria & RACI for AuroraDX

Hi Samir / team —

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we start the POC: 

Summary of what AuroraDX wants to validate:
- End-to-end latency and throughput for clinical-document summarization at 2k-4k token prompts
- Semantic consistency vs. current rules-based outputs (sample accuracy target below)
- Cost per processed document at expected volumes (est. 50k/month)

Proposed success criteria (attached spreadsheet includes metrics):
- Avg tail latency (95th) < 350ms for single-request baseline
- Throughput >= 25 reqs/sec for batched inference with < 10% degradation in precision
- Semantic F1 >= 0.82 vs. your human-labeled sample set
- Integration: delivery of inference endpoint and prefix-caching validation in staging

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize RACI & procurement kickoff
- Week 1: infra staging access + network checklist + import sample dataset (AuroraDX)
- Week 2: run load and quality tests; share interim results
- Week 3: final report + go/no-go decision

Draft RACI / ownership (please confirm):
- Infra/Cloud access: AuroraDX infra team (we requested staging VPC peering) — owner: Samir Gupta (you)
- App integration (API contracts, sample data): AuroraDX app lead — owner: Jenna Martin <jenna.martin@auroradx.com>
- Security / compliance evidence (network, encryption, SOC2 artifacts): Redwood security lead — owner: Aditya Rao (aditya.rao@redwood.ai)
- Implementation / endpoint config & dev integration support: Redwood solutions engineer — owner: Dev Patel (dev.patel@redwood.ai)
- Trial coordination and results / success criteria sign-off: Marissa Cole (me) / AuroraDX PO

Action items for this week:
1) Samir — confirm staging peering window and provide VPC CIDR + egress rules
2) Jenna — confirm sample dataset drop location and PO for PII-masked export
3) Procurement (AuroraDX) — confirm SOW/PO cadence; looped procurement contact in reply
4) Redwoods: we'll provision a test pool and share access details once VPC is scheduled

Attachments: Auroradx_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (metrics + tests), Auroradx_Network_Reqs.pdf (network checklist)

If that looks right I can update the spreadsheet and lock timelines — aiming to start infra work Tuesday.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — this is great, and mirrors our notes. A few quick clarifications: 

- On the success criteria: can we use Precision/Recall macro instead of F1 for the clinical labels? We need the ability to show false negatives separately for regulatory review. If so, please add a target for Precision >= 0.80 and Recall >= 0.78.
- Staging peering: we can do Tuesday 6/23 10:00–12:00 PT. I'll share the CIDR and a temporary user for the import.
- Procurement: looping Jenna and procurement alias — Jenna, procurement will need a short SOW with payment milestones to approve the trial.

Also, two asks from our side: 
1) Can Redwood provide a short network diagram of the staging setup (we need it for our security review)?
2) Will Redwood be able to run a prefix-cache validation test (we discussed) on our 500-sample set?

Cheers,
Samir
Dir. of Engineering, AuroraDX
